<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Anti-defection law:</strong> The Supreme Court has sought responses from the Centre and the Election Commission regarding a public interest litigation seeking reforms to the anti-defection law.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQSE1XS3M1dVpiaHRlMElSNWR2bENrN3BxcXh6dVpMTWxTd0hJRzRRZl96eWtyVjlHazRDbW81b2xhY1ZZMzhQYzRtNEtZcnRXaG44X3lfZ000NklnT3NUdEVHdXN5SkJBckRTYUk4TllBWTJOX0RMRENuQTdpNGwzMVhZZkdMQURxdnl3NVUxX0lTeWNNNDM3YUVobF9kTWxkWnd1SUFVekthb1VZNktoemVxYmh2N0tKMG9oV1h0RQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE4walpUTEluTmpLWUFIdXp3YmFoeEktR3VEdTJTc0NvZ05lNHNFeXZTbjNYN1VLUTJKRXIwNTczTXlVel9ycGdJN2FWQWNfeERvMk9PLVRibXlMMk1GTUVQX2p5Z2tlSGJYQWxHczNtQjQzRnFsdlRN?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxQQXNubnJoeVRmUkpoSlZoSDR5dzhiem42RlBHcy1LcGIydXBkTGwxaDN2ajBZaWlMNnc0UTk4NldEOG40YUZVdkZvZV9HRWZHTTJMeklYcGw3SlJWMEJfRDl0clhzUmcxRXdvQmgyaXl2TFZMQ0tsWHlEaEtabU5hV2ZzcURTOGdwNlUzeGc0Y1l0WGhwX0tUdEx0QTUydkVQTk1NeVNMbE16cV9LemdOV0NJOWE0R00?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>
